summary.text: Shelly Fyant is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 91 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A consultant focused on food security and cultural awareness, she previously served on the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes (CSKT) Tribal Council and as tribal chairwoman.

paragraphs.text: Shelly Fyant was born in St. Ignatius, Montana, and earned a high school diploma from Ronan High School in 1975, an associate degree from Haskell Indian Nations University in 1978 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 1989.

Her career experience includes working as a consultant focusing on food security and cultural awareness and appreciation, and she is affiliated with the Bitterroot Salish, Confederated Salish & Kootenai Tribes.
Fyant served on the Arlee school board from 2012 to 2014 and on the CSKT Tribal Council from 2014 to 2021, including as Tribal Chairwoman from 2020 to 2021.

She has also served as a board member of the Western Leaders Network, on the Buffalo Nations Food Systems Initiative Advisory Council and the Leadership Montana Indigenous Advisory Council, and as food sovereignty chair of the Arlee Community Development Corporation.
Fyant defeated Republican David Passieri in the 2024 general election for District 91.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, House Local Government, House State Administration and House Legislative Administration committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Charles Headley in the general election.
